methodGroup.where: Screen-reader label for the method choice (radio group).

method.delivery.where: Method name; must match Shopify checkout's term for local delivery.

method.pickup.where: Method name; must match Shopify checkout's term for in-store pickup.

method.shipping.where: Method name; must match Shopify checkout's term for shipping.

location.label.where: Label of the pickup location selector.

location.instructions.where: Heading above the merchant's pickup instructions.

location.map.where: Link to the location on a map.

area.postcodeLabel.where: Label of the postcode input (local delivery). Use the local word (ZIP code, PLZ, CEP…).

area.choose.where: Placeholder option in the area dropdown.

area.covered.where: Shown after a successful postcode check. {postcode} = what the shopper typed.

area.coveredArea.where: Shown after choosing a covered area. {area} = area name.

area.notCovered.where: Postcode not covered. {postcode} = what the shopper typed.

area.trySwitch.where: Follows the not-covered message when other methods exist.

area.enterPostcode.where: Error when Check is pressed with an empty field.

date.label.delivery.where: Label for the date field (local delivery, or shipping when the date means arrival).

date.label.dispatch.where: Label for the date field when the shipping date means the day the parcel ships.

date.choose.where: Placeholder of the date dropdown / button.

calendar.prev.where: Accessible label for the previous-month arrow.

calendar.next.where: Accessible label for the next-month arrow.

calendar.today.where: Label for today's date (also used instead of the date when enabled).

calendar.tomorrow.where: Label for tomorrow's date (used instead of the date when enabled).

calendar.available.where: Screen-reader state for a bookable day.

calendar.selected.where: Screen-reader state for the chosen day.

reason.closed.where: Why a day can't be chosen: shop closed that day.

reason.holiday.where: Day closed for a holiday. {name} = holiday name (from the merchant, may be another language).

reason.vacation.where: Day closed because the shop is on vacation.

reason.tooSoon.where: Day is earlier than the preparation time allows.

reason.notOpen.where: Day before the merchant's launch date.

reason.productUnavailable.where: A product in the cart isn't sold on that day. {product} = product title.

reason.soldOut.where: A product's daily limit is reached. {product} = product or rule name.

reason.mayShift.where: Extra note for holidays based on a lunar calendar.

slot.label.where: Label above the time slot chips.

slot.group.where: Screen-reader label for the slot group.

slot.left.where: Shown on a slot or day with few spots left.

slot.busy.where: Shown under the slots when few remain.

fee.where: Surcharge next to a date or slot. {amount} = formatted price incl. currency.

fee.label.where: Name of the surcharge line explained to the shopper.

summary.delivery.where: Summary line after choosing (local delivery or shipping arrival). {date} = formatted date or Today/Tomorrow.

summary.deliveryTime.where: Same with a time slot. {time} = e.g. 10:00–12:00.

summary.dispatch.where: Shipping when the date is the dispatch day.

change.where: Link next to the summary to change the choice.

tzNote.where: Shown when the shopper's device is in another time zone. {zone} = translated time-zone name from the browser, e.g. 'Central European Time'.

required.where: Inline error when trying to check out without a date.

requiredSlot.where: Inline error when a slot is required.

requiredItems.where: Per-item mode: an item has no date.

invalidated.where: Shown when a saved date became invalid (cutoff passed, slot full, cart changed).

noCommonDate.where: No date suits every item. {product} = the restricting product.

minOrder.where: Minimum order value not met. {method} = method name, {amount} = formatted amount.

vacation.where: Default vacation message. {date} = last closed day, {nextDate} = first open day.

loading.where: While the widget prepares the calendar.

product.earliest.delivery.where: Product page message. {date} = formatted date or Today/Tomorrow.

product.earliest.dispatch.where: Product page message when the shipping date is the dispatch day.

product.countdown.delivery.where: Countdown before the cutoff. {duration} = e.g. 2 h 15 min. Use the select so 'today/tomorrow/on <date>' reads naturally.

duration.hm.where: Countdown duration with hours. Numbers are formatted by the code.

product.pickDate.where: Product page picker heading (date per item).

product.dateRequired.where: Product page error when the date is missing.

item.dateFor.where: Per-item mode in the cart. {product} = product title.

validation.missingDate.where: Checkout error from the validation Function.

validation.dateUnavailable.where: Checkout error. {date} = the date as the shopper saw it.

checkout.renameDate.where: Renamed delivery option at checkout. {option} = the store's option name, {date} = chosen date (+ time).

thankyou.heading.where: Heading of the thank-you / order status block.

thankyou.delivery.where: Thank-you text. {date} may include the time slot.

thankyou.ics.where: Link label for the calendar file.

calendar.eventDelivery.where: Calendar event title. {order} = order number like #1001.

snippet.method.where: Label in order emails / packing slips.

snippet.date.where: Label in order emails / packing slips.

snippet.time.where: Label in order emails / packing slips.

snippet.location.where: Label in order emails / packing slips.

requiredLocation.where: Inline error when trying to check out with store pickup but no pickup location chosen.

notes.label.where: Label of the optional notes box under the date (delivery instructions or gift message; merchants can rename it).

notes.placeholder.where: Example text inside the empty notes box.
